author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Adam welcomes back Don Bies, former ILM model supervisor and Lucasfilm archivist, to the cave to check out some physical artifacts from his Star Wars modelmaking portfolio. One particularly interesting piece is a cutaway lightsaber Don constructed for the Star Wars Visual Dictionary, which was the first time fans got an official look inside Luke's lightsaber hilt!
